notes: The control arm is the exact conventional render that serves this model today, including its discarded emptyDir compile cache.

Cold arms measure PodScheduled to first validated semantic response. Promotion arms measure from the prober's own clock, which includes the trigger dispatch, so their reported activation is conservative.

Shared-filesystem page-cache state is not controlled between cold attempts and is recorded as an uncontrolled variable. host-memory-residency is the only arm that guarantees residency, and the per-attempt runtime weight-load seconds make the difference visible.

messages.content: Reply with the single word READY.

qwen3-8b.residency_mode_finding: locked-payload-residency is unavailable on this cluster for a non-root runtime identity. Measured live on the H100 capacity-block node as uid 1000 with capabilities.add=[IPC_LOCK]: CapBnd=0x4000, CapEff=0x0, RLIMIT_MEMLOCK=8388608 bytes. Added capabilities reach only the bounding set for a non-root container, so mlock fails with ENOMEM. The holder therefore runs mapped-payload-residency and reports residency_guaranteed=false rather than claiming a guarantee.
qwen3-8b.node_name_source: --node, because the node is a run-time target rather than a model fact

boltzgen.blocker: BoltzGen has a qualified H100 runtime image but no serving HTTP endpoint on this cluster yet; its scientific batch adapter runs as a Job rather than a readiness-probed Service.
boltzgen.activation_requirement: Populate the same keys as the qwen3-8b target once a BoltzGen serving profile with a readiness probe and a semantic request exists, then run the campaign with --target boltzgen. No mechanism code changes are needed.
